name: Processed CI nowcasting dataset
model_or_instrument: GOES-16 ABI and MRMS composite reflectivity
size_as_stated: 94 618 samples. Of these, 45 077 and 19 320 samples from June to July 2020 are used for training and validation, respectively, while 30 221 samples collected in June 2021 are for testing.
resolution: 48 km x 48 km square patches (32 x 32 pixels at 1.5 km resolution), 7 infrared channels

scales.note: 94,618 samples of 32x32 patches (48 km x 48 km at 1.5 km resolution) across 7 IR channels spanning June-July 2020 and June 2021.
